ORDER % 21.02.2023 CRL.M.A. 4653/2023 (exemption)
Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.A. 4652/2023 (for interim protection)
Present bail application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 180/2022 under Section 420/467/468/471/120B IPC registered at P.S Alipur, Delhi.

Learned Senior counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that briefly the case of the complainant/prosecution is that one Rajender Kumar @ Rajender Malhotra forged the Will of the father of the complaint in the year 2001 and on the basis of the forged Will the property was sold to one Tej Singh, Anurag Goel (present petitioner) and Sanjeet.
It has been alleged these accused persons in collusion with the Revenue officials got the property mutated on their name unfairly.

Learned senior counsel submits that it has come on the record in the order dated 08.02.2023 in Bail Appln. 3578/2022 titled Tej Singh vs. State (Govt. of NCT of Delhi) that the investigating officer on a pointed query of this court has submitted that there was no evidence on record to demonstrate who created the alleged forged Will.

entities.text: Bail Appln. 3578/2022 titled Tej Singh vs. State (Govt. of NCT of Delhi)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned senior counsel submits that Rajender Kumar @
Rajender Malhotra has already been granted bail by the learned trial court vide order dated 03.06.2022, on the basis of compromise between the complainant and the said co-accused.
Co-accused Tej Singh has also been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 08.02.2023.
Learned senior counsel submits that the petitioner/accused herein is ready and willing to join the investigation and shall cooperate as and when directed.

He has further submitted that notice under Anurag Goel vs State (Govt Of Nct Of Delhi) on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137800748/
1 Section 41A Cr.P.C has still not been served and the investigating officer with an ulterior motive has got the NBW issued against the petitioner.

entities.text: Anurag Goel vs State (Govt Of Nct Of Delhi)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Issue notice.
Learned APP accepts notice.
Learned APP submits that this is a serious case where private person in collusion with the revenue officials are plundering government property.
Learned APP submits that the case of the present accused is different from accused Tej Singh who was granted bail after around 7 months of custody.
Learned APP submits that he may be given some time to file a detailed status report.
Let detailed status report be filed.
With the above directions, the application stands disposed of.
DINESH KUMAR SHARMA, J FEBRUARY 21, 2023 rb..
